title: What's New: Supply Chain Management - overview (2026 release wave 1)

features.name: Quality Management Extension
features.description: New extension available to automate quality management processes and ensure industry and legal compliance. Checks goods when received or produced with flexible and customizable steps.
caveats: Requires separate video for detailed usage information

features.name: Drop Shipment Process Enhancements
features.description: More ways to create purchase documents for drop shipment sales documents. Includes new toggle to indicate drop shipment lines, flexible order posting, and undo capability for mistakes.
caveats: Standard create purchase order action works for both normal and drop shipment scenarios

features.name: Purchase Order Matching
features.description: Ability to receive invoices before orders are received and link purchase invoices to purchase orders. Supports linking single invoice line to multiple purchase orders and receipts, and posting marked orders as received.
caveats: Not all documents allow these scenarios - check documentation for specifics
Requires settings configuration on specific documents

features.name: Filter Support for Get Receipt Lines
features.description: New filter support in vendor order, vendor shipment, and vendor item number fields for get receipt lines processes. Same enhancement available for get shipment and service shipment lines.
caveats: Service shipment lines have fewer fields available for filtering

features.name: Sending Posted Sales Documents
features.description: Ability to send posted sales shipments and posted sales credit returns via email with attachment support. New attachment effect box for documents without configured emails.

features.name: Purchase Quote without Vendor
features.description: Create purchase quotes without creating vendors upfront. Vendor is created automatically when quote is converted to order, similar to sales quote process. Requires vendor template for automatic creation.
caveats: Vendor template required for automatic vendor creation

features.name: Service Order Creation by Item Toggle
features.description: Toggle activation that allows batch job to create separate service orders per service item in service contracts. Previously only created single order even with multiple contract items.

features.name: Approval Workflows for Item Journals and Requisition Worksheets
features.description: Support for approvals in item journals and requisition worksheets. Uses workflow templates with new actions to send to approval, cancel, and see status. Focuses on batches not individual lines for performance reasons.
caveats: Only batches supported not individual lines due to performance

features.name: Item Statistics with Copilot Summarization
features.description: Enhanced item statistics page showing numbers across different categories and periods with drill down capability. Copilot summarization promotes interesting numbers in the summary view.

features.name: Item Variants with Pictures and Attributes
features.description: Item variants now support pictures and attributes, going deeper than item level. Used by Shopify connector as well for enhanced product information management.

features.name: Description Two Field in BOM and Routings
features.description: New Description Two field added to production BOM and routings, propagated to related tables like planning orders and production order components. Copies value from item, work center, or machine center.

features.name: Routing Status Change Notification
features.description: User notification warning when closing routing without changing status to indicate completion. Settings available in My Notifications to control warning display per user.

features.name: Item Tracking on Manufacturing Journals
features.description: Item tracking support on manufacturing output journals with serial number assignment. Explode routing action now splits output operations into multiple lines when serial tracking required, one line per unit.
caveats: Explode routing action behavior changed for serial tracked items

features.name: Work In Progress Account Posting Improvement
features.description: Eliminated need for blank location in inventory posting setup for WIP accounting. Now posts capacity and output to WIP account using actual production order location, allowing per-location WIP accounts.
caveats: More complex setup but enables per-location WIP accounts

features.name: Subcontracting Production Support
features.description: New subcontracting capabilities for manufacturing including production order routing subcontracting details fact box, create subcontracting purchase documents, transfer orders for materials, warehouse receipts, and item charge allocation.
features.status_evidence_quote: It's not something you can see on April 1st or 2nd because it will be uh become available later in the season
caveats: More details to follow as release approaches
